rules.codeLicense: MIT only (SPDX: MIT) for components and boilerplates. Registries that mix 'free + pro' are allowed ONLY for their free/MIT items; verify per item.
rules.fonts: OFL/SIL or system stacks only for webfonts (Google Fonts OK). Record license per font.
rules.evidence: Every entry: repo + how MIT was verified (GitHub API spdx_id or LICENSE) + date.

registries.name: @shadcn
registries.notes: Core registry. Add by bare name (button, card, …) or block names.

registries.name: @reui
registries.notes: 1773 free items; premium blocks excluded — verify item is free before use. URL needs {style} (radix|base) — set the style segment in the project namespace config.

registries.name: @velora
registries.notes: 64 items, token-aware (items carry cssVars). llms.txt lists sizes/deps.

registries.name: @cult-ui
registries.notes: 157 items. Directory health status 'observing' — re-check at use. If cult-ui.com rate-limits (429/Vercel checkpoint), onboard from the repo mirror: apps/www/public/r/registry.json (raw.githubusercontent.com/nolly-studio/cult-ui/main/apps/www/public/r/registry.json) saved to a file + --catalog-file.

registries.name: @daisyui
registries.notes: NOT a shadcn registry. Alternative base via Tailwind plugin; never mix with shadcn token flow.
